mapper.select: SELECT j.id,j.publisher_id,j.status,j.title,j.category,j.recruitment_mode,j.required_count,j.starts_at,j.duration_minutes,u.organization,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM job_application a WHERE a.job_id=j.id AND a.status<>'WITHDRAWN') AS applications,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM job_application a WHERE a.job_id=j.id AND a.status='ACTIVE') AS accepted_count,j.remaining_count AS remaining,CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM job_application a WHERE a.job_id=j.id AND a.status='ACTIVE')>0 THEN 'ACCEPTED' ELSE 'UNACCEPTED' END AS acceptance_status FROM job j JOIN publisher_user u ON u.id=j.publisher_id WHERE j.publisher_id=#{publisherId} AND j.status='OPEN' AND j.starts_at>#{now} ORDER BY j.created_at DESC,j.id DESC LIMIT 12 OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM job j WHERE j.publisher_id=#{publisherId} AND j.status='OPEN' AND j.starts_at>#{now}

SELECT j.id,j.publisher_id,j.status,j.title,j.category,j.recruitment_mode,j.required_count,j.starts_at,j.duration_minutes,u.organization,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM job_application a WHERE a.job_id=j.id AND a.status<>'WITHDRAWN') AS applications,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM job_application a WHERE a.job_id=j.id AND a.status='ACTIVE') AS accepted_count,j.remaining_count AS remaining,CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM job_application a WHERE a.job_id=j.id AND a.status='ACTIVE')>0 THEN 'ACCEPTED' ELSE 'UNACCEPTED' END AS acceptance_status,(SELECT mine.status FROM job_application mine WHERE mine.job_id=j.id AND mine.student_id=#{viewerId}) AS application_status,CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM job_application mine WHERE mine.job_id=j.id AND mine.student_id=#{viewerId} AND mine.status IN ('ACTIVE','PENDING')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS applied FROM job j JOIN publisher_user u ON u.id=j.publisher_id WHERE j.publisher_id=#{viewerId} WHERE j.status='OPEN' ORDER BY j.created_at DESC,j.id DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT j.*,u.organization FROM job j JOIN publisher_user u ON u.id=j.publisher_id WHERE j.id=#{id}
SELECT u.id,u.nickname,u.avatar_version FROM job_application a JOIN student_user u ON u.id=a.student_id WHERE a.job_id=#{jobId} AND a.status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY a.created_at,a.id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM job_application WHERE job_id=#{jobId} AND status<>'WITHDRAWN'
SELECT a.status,CASE WHEN p.id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS paid FROM job_application a LEFT JOIN job_payment p ON p.application_id=a.id WHERE a.job_id=#{jobId} AND a.student_id=#{studentId}
mapper.update: UPDATE job SET remaining_count=remaining_count+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND remaining_count<required_count AND status='OPEN'
mapper.select: SELECT student_id,status FROM job_application WHERE id=#{id} AND job_id=#{jobId}
mapper.update: UPDATE job_application SET status=#{status},reviewed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT id,status FROM job_application WHERE job_id=#{jobId} AND student_id=#{studentId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM job_payment WHERE application_id=#{applicationId}
mapper.update: UPDATE job_application SET status='WITHDRAWN',withdrawn_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN ('ACTIVE','PENDING')
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM job_payment p JOIN job_application a ON a.id=p.application_id WHERE a.job_id=#{jobId}
